name: Surface interaction and terminal classification
purpose: Verify surface outcome accounting and distinguish physical lunar escape from finite-domain loss.
production_capability: Installed sphere callback and production mover terminal path.
configuration: Normal SPICE neutral-Na baseline; 4096 surface trials; two fixtures immediately inside the production +30 R_Moon sunward boundary.
independent_reference: Status conservation, outward-normal invariant, and Moon-relative inertial specific energy |v_LSO+Omega cross r|^2/2-GM/r.
frame_time_convention: Positions/velocities recorded in LSO; energy velocity transformed to Moon-relative inertial components.
procedure: Sample surface callback; drive two states through the same domain terminal status; label by pre-exit energy sign.
metrics: compiled AMPS domain-loss and normal-completion status values
acceptance_criteria: All 4096 outcomes accounted; no unknown/inward re-emission; both exits equal the compiled _PARTICLE_LEFT_THE_DOMAIN_ status and not the compiled normal-completion status; physical fixture energy >0 and numerical-loss energy <=0.
expected_pass_result: Surface outcomes conserve counts and terminal loss labels are physically distinct.
status_semantics: PASS verifies classification and callback behavior; it is not the later global surface-reservoir conservation gate.
